text_block_list.text:
North Flight wasn't feeling well, so I 
brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for worrying you. I'll make sure 
to recover completely.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin!! Bakushin, 
Bakushin, Bakushin!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin!! Bakushin!! Baku!! Shin!! 
Shiinnnn!!!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: WELCOMEEEEE!!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: !? Everyone, what's wrong...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Flight-san! One order of 
Bakushin Ramen, right!? Right away, 
ma'am!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
One order of Bakushin Ramen, coming 
righhht up!!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
One second later--

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
THANK YOU FOR WAITING!! HERE IS YOUR 
BAKUSHIN RAMEN!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
No, I haven't been waiting at all...!! And 
wow—that's an incredible amount...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right away!! One order of Bakushin Fried 
Chicken coming right up!! Understood-ッ!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
One order of Bakushin Fried Chicken coming 
right up!!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I didn't ask for this...! Everyone, 
please calm down and let's talk... !?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's impossible, Flight-san!! Because we 
are full steam ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"One bite and you too will dash forward 
with bakushin spirit!! Come now, have 
some!! Go on!!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not just Bakushin O-chan, but those two as 
well— I-I don't get it... I don't 
understand at all...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
However, if... if eating this can change 
something— —Yes. Let's eat!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...!! It's delicious! And it feels like 
something is surging through my whole 
body—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!! Of course!! I am thrilled to see 
that you have successfully become 
Bakushin-like as well, Flight-san!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if it's 'Bakushin-like' or 
not, but it's super delicious... Thank 
you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. Was that... a dream? Is everyone back 
to normal? ...Ah, thank goodness.

Perhaps stimulated by the curious 
experience, North Flight's condition 
seemed to improve.
